title: Building my own Fantasy strategy game
author: Winter_Management846
selftext:
Paran is a fantasy strategy game inspired by Hearts of Iron 4.  
In a fictional world, you take control of a nation to seize world domination.

Command your troops to crush your enemies with full force.  
Expand your infrastructure to gain bonuses.  
Forge alliances, betray your allies, or fight your way to power on your own.

The game was created with the help of ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.  
Claude makes the code and bugfixes, with gemini i try to figure out mistakes in the code and chatgpt is making some artstyle.

So what do you think?
